ns2:course.label: Individual Topics
ns2:course.description: Individual topics in research conducted under the supervision of faculty members in the School of Integrative Biology. Designed for graduate students who would like to become more familiar with specialized fields of study prior to committing themselves to a specific area for their doctorate degree. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
